claim.operational_target: Persist isolated people, raw sources, conversations, frozen content contracts, rendered replies, optional local reality-answer comparisons, pending optimization candidates, and rollbackable exploratory versions; refuse when no confirmed in-scope material supports a reply.
non_claims: validated prediction of a real person's next response
recovery of beliefs, values, personality, or psychological mechanisms
a general large language model persona or complete-person Skill
automatic verification that a supplied or fetched source is truthful or complete
alternatives: the reply quality is explained entirely by lexical retrieval from the saved source
a generic evidence-grounded answer performs as well as the named-person model
topic overlap rather than person-specific response structure explains apparent relevance
claim.scope: One selected person per isolated local workspace; text, TXT, Markdown, HTML, text-bearing PDF, and direct HTTP(S) URL sources; local extractive response baseline; optional local verified-answer comparison.

identifiability.distinguishing_evidence: Product behavior is distinguished by per-person storage isolation, deterministic source-role filtering, zero comparison calls when disabled, frozen-contract rendering, and held-out source exclusion. Person-specific prediction requires future sealed real dialogue evaluation and wrong-person/generic/retrieval controls.
unidentified_questions: whether the extracted answer predicts what the person would say now
whether retrieved wording reflects stable person-specific cognition rather than source topic
whether style markers are recognizable without identity and topic leakage

evidence.completeness_boundary: The local system binds supplied bytes, extraction, speaker metadata, source locator, hashes, near-duplicates, source role, and version membership. It cannot prove the user supplied every source, that a remote page is authentic, or that a speaker label is historically correct without external review.

computation.uncertainty_scope: Confidence is a bounded retrieval-support score, not a calibrated probability of the person's true next response; missing or weak evidence produces refusal.

results.summary: 13 focused conversation and HTTP tests passed

Raw source review, multi-turn reply and refusal, opt-in reality comparison, pending optimization, gated v3 creation, v2 rollback, reload persistence, and zero console warnings/errors passed; unchecked reality comparison telemetry remained zero until explicit opt-in

remaining_limitations: No trainable person response adapter or language-model backend is included in this local dependency-light MVP.
Runtime web discovery from only a person's name is not implemented without a configured external search backend; direct URL collection is implemented.
PDF extraction requires embedded text and does not perform OCR.
Reality-answer verification remains pending human review and does not automatically establish historical authenticity.
No sealed real-person holdout evaluation currently supports a response-prediction accuracy claim.
